item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-15 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 15 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Network Edge / VPN is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (5). Cisco has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2016-7255 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 895 positions.
